receipts.first_text_witness: Somewhere out there is someone taking home the same paycheck you are. Same city, same zero in the same account the year you both turned 29. One of you stops working 13 years before the other, and nothing in your bank app will ever tell you which of you it is.
receipts.last_text_witness: you have, how much time. Jade owned 22 years by the time Jaimie owned 10, and he never once out-earned her. She had more money, he had more life. Whatever your number is, it's either going up or it isn't, and it does not care even slightly how your year is going. Go find out which one you're on, and come tell me in our school community when it moves.
